edits.reason: Replace PaC PR event/body base SHA with local BASE_SHA (default merge-base with main) and include committed, staged, unstaged and untracked changes.

adaptations: PaC pull_request event gate dropped: local run is always treated as PR context
BASE_SHA (merge-base HEAD with base ref, default main) replaces body.pull_request.base.sha
Diff base..HEAD replaced by git diff BASE_SHA against working tree unioned with untracked files via git ls-files --others --exclude-standard, keeping vendor and _test.go filters
steps.script:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -eu
git config --global --add safe.directory "$WORKSPACE"

base_sha="$BASE_SHA"
if [[ -z "$base_sha" ]]; then
  echo "Base SHA is empty, skipping"
  exit 0
fi

files=$( { git diff --name-only "$base_sha" -- '*.go'; git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -- '*.go'; } | sort -u | grep -v '^vendor/' | grep '_test\.go$' || true)
if [ -z "$files" ]; then
  echo "No test files modified."
  exit 0
fi

failed=0
while IFS= read -r file; do
  [ -z "$file" ] && continue
  [ ! -f "$file" ] && continue

  bad_names=$(grep -n '^func Test[A-Za-z]*_[A-Za-z]' "$file" || true)
  if [ -n "$bad_names" ]; then
    echo "ERROR: $file: test function names must use PascalCase (no underscores):"
    echo "$bad_names"
    failed=1
  fi

  bad_asserts=$(grep -En '\bt\.(Errorf|Fatalf|Fatal|Error)\(' "$file" || true)
  if [ -n "$bad_asserts" ]; then
    echo "WARNING: $file: use gotest.tools/v3/assert instead of t.Errorf/t.Fatalf/t.Fatal/t.Error:"
    echo "$bad_asserts"
  fi
done <<< "$files"

if [ "$failed" -ne 0 ]; then
  echo "Fix violations above. See AGENTS.md for testing conventions."
  exit 1
fi
echo "All modified test files pass convention checks."
